purpose: VFX concept storyboards, not runtime assets
bolt:
Use case: compositing / stylized-concept. Create a professional GAME VFX ART-DIRECTION STORYBOARD for Asterveil: Fateweave, using the attached real 390x844 gameplay screenshot as the locked edit target.
OUTPUT: one polished wide storyboard sheet, approximately 2048x1152, four equal tall portrait panels left to right. Each panel is the SAME complete portrait gameplay screenshot, uniformly fitted, with a small clean dark header above and numbered English captions below: 01 GATHER, 02 TRAVEL, 03 CONTACT, 04 DISSOLVE. Title at top: BOLT / ASTRAL THREAD. Minimal editorial typography, no extra game UI.
PRESERVE: exact six existing chibi characters, their identities, poses, faces, costumes, weapons, scale and screen positions; exact ruins/background, perspective, framing, existing HUD, HP labels, portraits and buttons. Do not redraw or redesign the game. Only add a VFX overlay and the outside-the-game storyboard labels. Keep character faces and game UI readable.
ACTION: the existing purple/white-haired mage in the UPPER LEFT casts diagonally down-right at the existing dark purple horned brute in the LOWER RIGHT. Only that brute is the recipient. The upper-right red-haired enemy and all other allies remain unaffected.
STYLE: art-directed painted anime fantasy effects that fit this illustrated game, elegant thin bright cores, feathered edges, deliberate tapered ribbon shapes, small faceted fragments, controlled emissive bloom. Cyan-white core with lavender/violet secondary light and very sparse warm star points. Transparent-looking layered light over the real field. Rich shape design, not a programmer's straight line, plain circle, solid polygon or uniform particle spray.
01 GATHER: a compact crescent of violet light and 3 tiny star motes around the mage's staff tip, no impact at target yet.
02 TRAVEL: one asymmetric needle/comet of cyan-white energy with a tapered curved lavender silk-like wake, clear diagonal travel toward the brute's torso, localized width at most 25 percent of one actor. This is a projectile, not a continuous laser beam.
03 CONTACT: a compact offset four-point starburst and 2 short curved energy petals at the brute's torso, 5-7 shards following arrival direction; face, armor and silhouette remain visible. Peak radius around 45 CSS pixels at original screenshot scale. No whole-body white silhouette, no explosion cloud, no global flash, no AoE. Do not paint additional damage numbers or alter HP; this is an art-only overlay concept.
04 DISSOLVE: the core has vanished, 3-4 fading lavender wisps and pinpoints around the target, silhouettes unobscured.
Do not invent characters, props, scenery, logos, watermarks, companions, extra weapons, damage numbers or extra attacks. Keep compositing restrained enough for a 390px mobile playfield. This is an aspirational concept storyboard, not a playable game screenshot or finished animation asset.

TITLE: EXECUTE / ROSE-GOLD EDGE. Captions: 01 EDGE GLINT, 02 SINGLE CUT, 03 MARK RESONANCE, 04 FALLING SPARKS.
ACTION: only the existing red-haired swordswoman in the LOWER MIDDLE LEFT attacks the existing dark violet horned brute in the LOWER RIGHT. Upper-left mage does not cast. Existing marked target has a small pink four-point diamond sigil; it remains present in all four panels, it is NOT consumed, broken, removed or transferred.
PALETTE: pale warm gold blade core, soft ivory highlight, restrained rose-magenta edge echoing the target mark; no fire.
01: tiny gold glint on the swordswoman's existing blade, a short narrow trailing stroke; small unchanged pink target seal on the brute torso. No target impact.
02: one elegant oblique crescent cut following her blade toward the brute, tapered from thin beginning to sharp tip, slight etched texture and 3 tiny spark streaks. Single local slash around the brute, no second cut, no X attack, no huge full-field beam.
03: compact hard contact star at torso with a short secondary curved petal and 5 directional gold fragments. The persistent pink diamond gives a subtle halo in response to the landed hit; no CRITICAL label, no explosion, no body-whitening, no mark shattering. Let the enemy's face and armor dominate the silhouette.
04: all slash core gone, 3-4 small falling warm spark flecks and a very faint rose edge wisp, mark still present, field readable.
The slash's focal footprint should fit roughly one actor width; preserve the one hit/single target identity.
